title: Photodetectors for Neuromorphic Vision
content: Photodetectors based on 2D semiconductors and metal halide perovskites. We investigate optical properties and recombination dynamics for vision systems.

title: Nonlinear & Topological Photonics
content: Theoretical foundations of nonlinear optical properties. Development of advanced concepts like dielectric metasurfaces and topological photonics.

title: Photonics & Optical Transistors
content: Implementation of photonic devices for optical amplification and lasers, developing advanced concepts in collaboration with the TOPIN theory line.

title: Low-Dimensional Semiconductors
content: Synthesis and fundamental understanding of 2D materials. Tuning electronic properties via doping and characterization using unique ARPES techniques.

title: Metal Halide Perovskites for Optoelectronics
content: Preparation of polycrystalline and epitaxial thin films for memristors, LEDs, and solar cells. Characterization and modeling of key physical processes.

title: Artificial Quantum Systems
content: Quantum devices based on light-matter interaction: single-photon emitters, entangled photons, quantum cryptography, and quantum simulation.

title: Theory & Simulation of Quantum Materials
content: Study of electronic, optical, and magnetic properties in 2D materials using First-Principles and semi-empirical methods under external perturbations.

title: Advanced Materials Chemistry
content: Chemical synthesis of metal halide perovskites and metal oxides in solution/thin films. Applications in sensors and energy via Photo/Electro-catalysis.
